parameters.content: ## Enviar mensagem de lembrete da reunião

parameters.query:
SELECT
    cp.id,
    cp.cliente_nome,
    cp.empresa,
    cp.telefone,
    cp.email,
    cp.whatsapp,
    cp.dt_call,
    cp.responsavel_id,
    cp.dono_do_lead,
    cp.status,
    cp.mailing_id,
    COALESCE(cp.midia, m.midia) AS midia_id
FROM calls_pipeline cp
LEFT JOIN mailing m ON m.id = cp.mailing_id
WHERE cp.dt_call IS NOT NULL
  AND cp.dt_realizacao IS NULL
  AND cp.status <> 'descartado'
  AND cp.lixeira = 0
  AND STR_TO_DATE(cp.dt_call, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') >= NOW()
ORDER BY STR_TO_DATE(cp.dt_call, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') ASC;

nodes.name: Identificar a reunião agendada daquele lead

parameters.query:
SELECT
    h.nome_app,
    h.telefone,
    h.created_at
FROM "finamob-historico_mensagens" h
WHERE h.nome_app IN ('SDR-INBOUND', 'SDR-REMARKETING', 'SDR-PARCEIROS')
  AND regexp_replace(h.telefone, '\D', '', 'g') LIKE '%' || $1
ORDER BY h.created_at DESC
LIMIT 1;
